title: Locate and Inspect Settings Page Header Component
description: Identify the React component responsible for rendering the 'Settings' page header, including the main title and subtitle, to prepare for font size adjustments.
details: Search the codebase for the subtitle text (e.g., 'Manage your account settings') to quickly locate the relevant file, likely 'app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx' or a similar path. Inspect the JSX to confirm the use of shadcn/ui components such as <CardTitle> and <CardDescription>. Ensure you have identified the correct elements for the title and subtitle.
test_strategy: Confirm that the located component renders the 'Settings' title and subtitle as seen in the UI. No code changes are made in this step; validation is by inspection.

title: Adjust Tailwind CSS Font Size Classes
description: Modify the Tailwind CSS utility classes on the title and subtitle elements to decrease their font sizes according to design intent.
details: In the identified component, update the Tailwind font size classes on the title (e.g., change from 'text-3xl' to 'text-2xl') and on the subtitle (e.g., from 'text-base' to 'text-sm'). If these elements use shadcn/ui components, add or override the className prop as needed. Ensure the changes are scoped only to the settings page unless a global change is intended.
test_strategy: Visually verify that the font sizes of the title and subtitle have decreased. Check that the typographic hierarchy is preserved and that the change does not negatively impact layout or readability.

title: Validate Responsive Layout and Accessibility
description: Ensure that the reduced font sizes do not disrupt the responsive layout or accessibility of the settings page across devices.
details: Manually test the settings page on multiple screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) to confirm that the new font sizes maintain proper alignment, spacing, and readability. Check for any overflow, clipping, or accessibility issues (e.g., heading structure, contrast). Adjust margin or padding utilities if necessary to maintain visual balance.
test_strategy: Use browser dev tools to simulate various screen sizes and run accessibility checks (e.g., Lighthouse, axe). Confirm that all content remains readable and accessible.

title: Document and Submit Change for Review
description: Prepare a pull request documenting the visual change, including before-and-after screenshots and a clear description of the update.
details: Create a new branch, commit the changes, and open a pull request. In the PR description, include a summary of the change, affected files, and screenshots showing the previous and updated font sizes. Note any design considerations or accessibility checks performed. Request review from the UI/UX or frontend team as appropriate.
test_strategy: Reviewers should verify the screenshots and test the branch locally to confirm the visual update is correct and does not introduce regressions.
